`resetall
`timescale 1ns / 1ps
`default_nettype none

module priority_encoder #(
    parameter WIDTH = 4,
    parameter LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY = 0
)(
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] input_unencoded,
    output wire output_valid,
    output wire [$clog2(WIDTH)-1:0] output_encoded,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] output_unencoded
);
parameter LEVELS = WIDTH > 2 ? $clog2(WIDTH) : 1;
parameter W = 2**LEVELS;

generate
if (WIDTH == 128 && LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY == 0 && LEVELS == 7 && W == 128) begin : fast128
    wire [15:0] group_valid;
    wire [15:0] group_enable;
    wire [15:0] group_winner;
    wire [127:0] local_winner;
    wire [127:0] winner;
    wire [15:0] low_code [2:0];
    wire [15:0] high_code [3:0];

    for (genvar g = 0; g < 16; g = g + 1) begin : groups
        assign group_valid[g] = |input_unencoded[g*8 +: 8];
        if (g == 15) begin : last_group
            assign group_enable[g] = 1'b1;
        end else begin : other_group
            assign group_enable[g] = ~(|group_valid[15:g+1]);
        end
        assign group_winner[g] = group_valid[g] & group_enable[g];

        for (genvar j = 0; j < 8; j = j + 1) begin : bits_in_group
            if (j == 7) begin : top_bit
                assign local_winner[g*8+j] = input_unencoded[g*8+j];
            end else begin : lower_bit
                assign local_winner[g*8+j] = input_unencoded[g*8+j] &
                    ~(|input_unencoded[g*8+7:g*8+j+1]);
            end
            assign winner[g*8+j] = local_winner[g*8+j] & group_enable[g];
        end

        assign low_code[0][g] = group_enable[g] &
            (local_winner[g*8+1] | local_winner[g*8+3] |
             local_winner[g*8+5] | local_winner[g*8+7]);
        assign low_code[1][g] = group_enable[g] &
            (local_winner[g*8+2] | local_winner[g*8+3] |
             local_winner[g*8+6] | local_winner[g*8+7]);
        assign low_code[2][g] = group_enable[g] &
            (local_winner[g*8+4] | local_winner[g*8+5] |
             local_winner[g*8+6] | local_winner[g*8+7]);
        for (genvar b = 0; b < 4; b = b + 1) begin : upper_encoding
            if ((g & (1 << b)) != 0) begin : included
                assign high_code[b][g] = group_winner[g];
            end else begin : excluded
                assign high_code[b][g] = 1'b0;
            end
        end
    end
    assign output_valid = |group_valid;
    for (genvar b = 0; b < 3; b = b + 1) begin : low_outputs
        assign output_encoded[b] = |low_code[b];
    end
    for (genvar b = 0; b < 4; b = b + 1) begin : high_outputs
        assign output_encoded[b+3] = |high_code[b];
    end
    assign output_unencoded = {winner[127:1], (winner[0] | ~output_valid)};
end else begin : general_case
    wire [W-1:0] input_padded = {{W-WIDTH{1'b0}}, input_unencoded};
    wire [W/2-1:0] stage_valid [LEVELS-1:0];
    wire [W/2-1:0] stage_enc [LEVELS-1:0];
    for (genvar n = 0; n < W/2; n = n + 1) begin : loop_in
        assign stage_valid[0][n] = |input_padded[n*2+1:n*2];
        if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : lsb
            assign stage_enc[0][n] = !input_padded[n*2];
        end else begin : msb
            assign stage_enc[0][n] = input_padded[n*2+1];
        end
    end
    for (genvar l = 1; l < LEVELS; l = l + 1) begin : loop_levels
        for (genvar n = 0; n < W/(2*2**l); n = n + 1) begin : loop_compress
            assign stage_valid[l][n] = |stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1:n*2];
            if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : lsb
                assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] =
                    stage_valid[l-1][n*2] ?
                    {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:n*2*l]} :
                    {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]};
            end else begin : msb
                assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] =
                    stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1] ?
                    {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]} :
                    {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:n*2*l]};
            end
        end
    end
    assign output_valid = stage_valid[LEVELS-1];
    assign output_encoded = stage_enc[LEVELS-1];
    assign output_unencoded = 1 << output_encoded;
end
endgenerate
endmodule
`resetall
",
  "bottleneck": "The original encoder propagates encoded bits through six dependent priority-multiplexer levels, then decodes the resulting index to generate output_unencoded. This serial encode-then-decode path is a likely maximum-arrival bottleneck.",
  "rewrite": "For the specified configuration, partition the input into sixteen eight-bit groups. Compute local winning bits and group validity in parallel, suppress groups with higher-priority valid groups, and generate the one-hot output directly. Generate the encoded index with parallel masked reductions instead of a cascaded mux tree. Retain the original implementation for other parameter configurations.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "The direct one-hot path removes the encoded-index dependency and final decoder. Encoded outputs also use parallel reductions rather than six serial mux selections. Timing improvement is expected, but no numerical gain or passing STA result is claimed without the specified mapping and electrical evaluation.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Additional local winner and group-suppression logic trades some shared mux-tree structure for parallel evaluation, while eliminating the index-to-one-hot decoder. Group enables have moderate fanout and may require buffering. Actual mapped area and compliance with the 4694.627520 um2 cap require tool verification.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Purely combinational, with no state or latency. For WIDTH=128 and MSB priority, the highest asserted input determines both encoded and one-hot outputs. All-zero input produces output_valid=0, output_encoded=0, and output_unencoded=1, matching the original nonzero default one-hot behavior. Original ports, unsigned declarations, parameter defaults, LEVELS and W overrides, and fallback truncation behavior are retained. No CRC ports or state exist in this module."
}
